notes.title: Language support termination notice (English)
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

First of all, I would like to express my deepest gratitude to all of you who have loved Truecolors.

Unfortunately, we have been forced to stop supporting Truecolors in English.

We are very sorry for all the users who used the English version.

Our development team wanted to continue to support the English version, but it was no longer possible due to lack of capacity.

We deeply apologize for not meeting the expectations of many English-language users.

We appreciate the support of the users who have played the English version of Truecolors so far and we will show you how it will continue to develop in the future.

This version includes bug fixes and some enhancements. See below for more information.

2. The error of recreating some objects and items has been corrected.

3. Some quest progress errors have been corrected.

notes.title: True Colors: Released as Early Access
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone.

Today, we released True Colors as Early Access.
It has awkward English dialogues because our team translated all directly, and also has some bugs.

So, you will be able to provide feedback through Steam Discussions, Direct feedbacks, and so on to us during early access.

Thank you.
